note: Veno-occlusive disease not mentioned; pioglitazone indicated for type 2 diabetes glycemic control.

quote: Joenja is indicated for the treatment of activated phosphoinositide 3-kinase delta syndrome (APDS)
note: Label names APDS only; 'inborn error of immunity' is a whole disease class.

quote: for the prophylaxis of acute transplant rejection in adult and paediatric (1 to 18 years of age) patients receiving allogeneic renal, cardiac or hepatic transplants
note: Prophylaxis of transplant rejection is graft rejection prevention.

quote: replacement therapy in primary (thyroidal), secondary (pituitary), and tertiary (hypothalamic) congenital or acquired hypothyroidism
note: Primary hypothyroidism explicitly named.

quote: Adults with overweight in the presence of at least one weight-related comorbid condition
note: Phentermine/topiramate chronic weight management indicated for adults with overweight.

quote: Not recommended for use to improve glycemic control in patients with type 1 diabetes mellitus.
note: Explicit limitation of use for T1DM.

quote: Acute Sinusitis ( 1.12 )
note: Only acute sinusitis (and lower RTI) indicated; edge is the broad upper respiratory infection category.
A depression rating-scale term; tenapanor indicated for IBS-C and hyperphosphatemia in CKD.

quote: congenital heart defects ... include pulmonary atresia, pulmonary stenosis, tricuspid atresia, tetralogy of Fallot, interruption of the aortic arch, coarctation of the aorta, or transposition of the great vessels
note: Palliative therapy for ductal-dependent defects explicitly listing transposition of the great vessels.

quote: indicated for the treatment of patients with phenylketonuria (PKU)
note: PKU explicitly named.
Preeclampsia not mentioned; only hypertension and angina indicated.

quote: management of severe and persistent pain in opioid tolerant patients, that requires an opioid analgesic
note: General severe pain indication; testicular pain is a narrower pain type.

quote: indicated for the acute treatment of migraine attacks with or without aura in adults
note: Migraine without aura explicitly covered.

quote: Adjunctive treatment of focal-onset seizures with or without secondary generalisation in adult patients with epilepsy
note: Treats seizures of epilepsy (adjunctive).

quote: relapsed or refractory (r/r) DLBCL and primary mediastinal large B cell lymphoma (PMBCL), after two or more lines of systemic therapy
note: PMBCL explicitly named.

quote: acute treatment of intermittent, stereotypic episodes of frequent seizure activity ... in patients with epilepsy 12 years of age and older
note: Epilepsy seizure clusters indicated; childhood absence epilepsy is a narrower subtype (borderline).

quote: adult patients with intermediate or poor risk advanced renal cell carcinoma, as a first-line treatment in combination with ipilimumab
note: RCC explicitly indicated.

quote: temporarily relieves minor aches and pains due to: backache muscle aches arthritis
note: Caffeine-containing analgesic combos list backache.

quote: reduction of elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) in patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension
note: OPTN-related OAG is a subtype of open-angle glaucoma.

quote: indicated for the treatment of pain and inflammation associated with cataract surgery
note: Treats postoperative ocular pain, a form of eye pain.

quote: treatment of moderately to severely active Crohn's disease in adults and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older
note: Crohn's disease explicitly named.
Only trigeminal neuralgia pain indicated; skin pain not mentioned.

quote: treatment of adults and pediatric patients 2 years of age and older with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis
note: UC explicitly named.

quote: treatment of adult patients with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal carcinoma whose tumors express PD-L1
note: Ovarian cancer indicated; stage III is narrower.

quote: Omidria is added to an ocular irrigating solution used during cataract surgery or intraocular lens replacement
note: Cataract surgery is the procedural setting; drug prevents miosis and postoperative pain.
PMDD not mentioned; text covers oral contraception only.
Only prophylaxis of common migraine; new daily persistent headache not mentioned.

quote: indicated in the long-term treatment of angina pectoris, to reduce angina attacks
note: Angina pectoris indicated; unstable angina is a subtype (borderline - also mentioned in warnings).

quote: treatment of moderate to severe acute pain, including postoperative pain, in adults
note: Postoperative pain explicitly named.

quote: acute gouty arthritis; acute rheumatic carditis; ankylosing spondylitis
note: Acute rheumatic carditis is a synonym of acute rheumatic heart disease.

quote: indicated for up to 8 weeks for the treatment of active duodenal ulcer
note: Duodenal ulcer explicitly named.

quote: Secondary therapy in non-Hodgkin's lymphoma and Hodgkin's disease
note: NHL indicated; familial NHL is a narrower form.

quote: Diphtheria: Infections due to Corynebacterium diphtheriae , as an adjunct to antitoxin
note: Diphtheria explicitly named.

quote: INTRA-ABDOMINAL INFECTIONS, including peritonitis, intra-abdominal abscess, and liver abscess
note: Intra-abdominal abscess explicitly named.

quote: for nausea associated with gastroenteritis
note: Treats nausea, not gastroenteritis itself.

quote: management of hypoglycemia due to hyperinsulinism associated with the following conditions ... Inoperable islet cell adenoma or carcinoma
note: Treats hypoglycemia caused by islet cell carcinoma, not the tumor.

quote: Primary or secondary adrenocortical insufficiency
note: Primary adrenocortical insufficiency explicitly listed.
